skill.name: advise-project-approach
skill.description: Research software project strategy, architecture, technology choices, implementation plans, operating costs, benchmarks, and comparable projects. Use it before building, during implementation, or after completion for broader project direction. It does not target narrow bug fixes or isolated file edits.
skill.summary: Evaluate software project choices using repository evidence, current research, explicit tradeoffs, and prioritized next steps.
skill.author: aaravkashyap12

content.value_statement: Software project choices often rely on generic advice, incomplete evidence, or hidden operating costs. This skill produces evidence-based recommendations with explicit tradeoffs and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Frames project goals, users, constraints, scale, budget, and deployment requirements.
Reviews repository structure and selected architecture files using read-only inspection.
Researches comparable projects, official documentation, pricing, and ecosystem guidance.
Compares two to four viable stacks or architectures against explicit decision criteria.
Recommends one path with alternatives, failure conditions, risks, and ordered next actions.
Adapts reports for pre-build, mid-build, and post-build project stages.
limitations: Requires clear constraints or a short intake before providing a confident recommendation.
Cannot verify current prices, releases, or comparables when browsing is unavailable.
Does not run repository code, tests, builds, or installation commands without permission.
Provides strategic review, not exhaustive security testing or narrow bug debugging.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product
use_cases.description: Select a practical stack, architecture, hosting model, and build sequence before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Correct an Active Build
use_cases.description: Review an existing repository and prioritize changes that improve fit, maintainability, cost, and delivery speed.

use_cases.title: Assess Launch Readiness
use_cases.description: Compare a completed project with credible references and identify architecture, operations, security, and deployment gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Frame a Project Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan [project] for [target users]. Ask the essential intake questions before recommending a stack or architecture.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the project idea is early or constraints are unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Technology Stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare suitable stacks for [project]. Consider my experience with [tools], budget of [budget], deadline of [deadline], and deployment preference of [target].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when requirements are known but the implementation stack is undecided.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Active Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the repository at [path or URL] using read-only inspection. Identify what to keep, change, and defer based on [project goals].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a mid-build architecture and implementation review.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Architecture and Vendor Costs
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [current architecture] for [scale and compliance needs]. Research comparables and current vendor limits, then provide alternatives, migration risks, failure conditions, and prioritized actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced decision involving architecture, pricing, and operational tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Plan a low-cost appointment platform for one developer and local clinics.
output_examples.output: Recommends a focused monolith, compares managed and self-hosted options, maps cost growth, and orders the first three vertical slices.

output_examples.input: Review my active repository and tell me whether the architecture should change.
output: Summarizes inspected files and evidence gaps.
Identifies strengths and prioritized architecture changes.
Explains alternatives, migration costs, and conditions that would change the verdict.

output_examples.input: Assess whether this completed service is ready for production.
output_examples.output: Produces a scoped readiness review covering architecture, reliability, security, deployment, observability, costs, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.

best_practices: Provide target users, must-have workflows, team skills, budget, deadline, and deployment constraints.
Share a repository path or public URL when requesting file-level findings.
State whether community sources may be used and identify decisions requiring current pricing evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not request a definitive stack recommendation without supplying decision-critical constraints.
Do not treat stars, popularity, or one comparable project as proof of fit.
Do not assume repository review authorizes dependency installation or code execution.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before building, during implementation, or before launch when broader project direction matters.

faq.question: Can it review an existing repository?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps the repository and selectively inspects relevant files using read-only methods.

faq.question: Will it run tests or install dependencies?
faq.answer: Not by default. It asks for permission before commands that may execute code or change state.

faq.question: Does it research current tools and pricing?
faq.answer: Yes, when browsing is available. It cites sources and observed dates for time-sensitive claims.

faq.question: Can it use community sources?
faq.answer: Yes, after you opt into sources such as X, Reddit, or YouTube.

faq.question: Does it replace a security audit?
faq.answer: No. It can assess security posture, but it does not perform exhaustive penetration testing or dependency auditing.
